profile.description: Optional QC profile. Use auto to infer from media kind/duration, or pass nto_long_form, generic_creator_video, shorts, audio, npo_podcast_or_audio, or thumbnail.

200.description: Cost estimate and effective guardrail behavior

process_async.description: When true, leave the job queued for POST /v1/qc/jobs/drain instead of running QC in the create request. Inline media and inline sidecars are not supported in queued mode.

duration_seconds.description: Declared media duration used for cost, usage, and abuse-limit preflight.

profile.description: Optional QC profile. Use auto to infer from media kind/duration, or pass nto_long_form, generic_creator_video, shorts, audio, npo_podcast_or_audio, or thumbnail. Explicit checks override profile defaults.

size_bytes.description: Declared media size used for upload abuse-limit preflight.

manifest_json.description: Optional storybook/edit manifest JSON used by repeat_fatigue for visual reuse and source-family analysis.

manifest_url.description: HTTPS URL for a remote storybook/edit manifest. Use for process_async jobs because inline sidecars are ephemeral.

transcript_text.description: Optional transcript/script text used by spoken_leaks without ASR spend.

transcript_json.description: Optional transcript JSON with text or words fields used by spoken_leaks.

transcript_base64.description: Optional base64-encoded transcript text or JSON.

transcript_url.description: HTTPS URL for a remote transcript text or JSON sidecar. Use for process_async jobs because inline sidecars are ephemeral.

watchlist_json.description: Optional pronunciation/term watchlist JSON for pronunciation_watchlist.

watchlist_url.description: HTTPS URL for a remote pronunciation/term watchlist JSON sidecar. Use for process_async jobs because inline sidecars are ephemeral.

expected_script_text.description: Optional locked script text used by script_faithfulness with transcript_text/transcript_json.

expected_script_json.description: Optional locked script JSON with text, script, or words fields used by script_faithfulness.

expected_script_base64.description: Optional base64-encoded locked script text or JSON.

expected_script_url.description: HTTPS URL for a remote locked-script text or JSON sidecar. Use for process_async jobs because inline sidecars are ephemeral.

chunk_sidecars_json.description: Optional array or object map of chunk QC sidecar JSON files used by chunk_sidecar_failures, for example packaged *.garble-report.json entries.

chunk_sidecars_base64.description: Optional base64-encoded JSON array or object map of chunk QC sidecar files.

chunk_sidecars_url.description: HTTPS URL for a remote JSON array or object map of chunk QC sidecars. Use for process_async jobs because inline sidecars are ephemeral.

plan_id.description: Optional plan preset for cost estimates and margin guardrails: creator, studio, network, or stress_99_5000.

plan_price_cents.description: Optional custom monthly plan price in cents for cost guardrail calculations.

included_minutes.description: Optional included monthly checked minutes for cost guardrail calculations.

ai_review_seconds.description: Internal or explicitly authorized model-review seconds for cost guardrails. Public included minutes are quality QC minutes.

cost_guardrail.description: Margin guardrail behavior when requested AI review would break the >95% gross-margin target.

200.description: Existing idempotent job returned

413.description: Duration or upload-size abuse limit exceeded

200.description: Recent jobs

post.description: Processes queued async QC jobs. Stored workspace API keys drain only jobs owned by their own workspace; operator/admin bearer keys can drain globally.

200.description: Queued jobs processed
Job status

200.description: Lifecycle events

get.summary: List report artifacts for a job

200.description: Artifacts
CSV marker export

post.summary: Import an external full-video gate verdict

200.description: Gate verdict imported

get.description: Operator/admin bearer keys can review recent usage globally. Stored workspace API keys are pinned to their own workspace usage ledger.

200.description: Usage ledger entries

get.description: Restricted owner/operator endpoint for internal pricing and margin review. Public customer agents should use GET /v1/usage for metered usage and must not rely on UploadCheck internal economics fields.

200.description: Restricted owner/operator usage economics summary

403.description: Insufficient scope for workspace customer keys

get.description: Returns fail-fast duration, upload-size, active-job, and usage-limit events for operator dashboard review. Stored workspace API keys are pinned to their own workspace even if a different workspace_id query parameter is supplied.

200.description: Persisted abuse-limit events, including usage_limit_exceeded plan/minute context when applicable

get.description: Returns Resend owner alert attempts for workspaces whose billable extra-minute spend crossed 100% of subscription value. Responses include billable overage spend and overage COGS audit context. Stored workspace API keys are pinned to their own workspace even if a different workspace_id query parameter is supplied.

200.description: Persisted spend alerts with status, provider, owner email, minutes, billable overage spend, overage rate, and COGS audit context

post.description: Creates a bearer key for agent clients. The raw apiKey is returned once; persisted records store only a SHA-256 hash and token prefix. Operator/admin bearer keys can provision any workspace; stored workspace API keys with api_keys:write are pinned to their own workspace, owner, plan economics, and overage cap even if another workspace, owner, plan, or cap is supplied.

overage_cap_cents.description: Approved extra-minute spend cap in cents after included deterministic minutes are exhausted. Zero or omitted means block at included minutes.

201.description: API key created; raw apiKey is shown once.

401.description: Missing or invalid admin API key

get.description: Operator/admin bearer keys can review redacted API keys globally or by workspace_id. Stored workspace API keys with api_keys:read are pinned to their own workspace even if a different workspace_id query parameter is supplied.

200.description: Redacted API key records

post.summary: Provision a checkout customer API key
post.description: Authenticated provisioning endpoint for checkout/webhook/account flows. It applies UploadCheck plan economics server-side and returns the raw apiKey only on the first successful provisioning call. Optional overage_cap_cents approves extra-minute spend after included deterministic minutes; zero or omitted blocks at included minutes. Stored workspace API keys with api_keys:write are pinned to their own workspace, owner, plan economics, and overage cap before checkout provisioning. Idempotent retries return the redacted key record without the bearer secret.

201.description: Provisioned API key; raw apiKey is shown once.

200.description: Existing provisioning record returned without bearer secret.

400.description: Invalid plan or missing owner email

401.description: Missing or invalid provisioning API key

post.description: Verifies Lemon Squeezy X-Signature with HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body using UPLOADCHECK_LEMONSQUEEZY_WEBHOOK_SECRET, then provisions paid subscription/order events into idempotent workspace API keys for MCP/API clients.

parameters.name: X-Signature
parameters.description: Lemon Squeezy HMAC-SHA256 hex digest of the raw request body.

201.description: Webhook verified and first-time API key provisioned.

200.description: Webhook verified and ignored or idempotently replayed without bearer secret.

503.description: Webhook signing secret is not configured.

200.description: Job cancelled

post.description: Creates a signed upload reservation. Stored workspace API keys force server-side workspace, owner, and key metadata onto the upload, ignoring client-supplied workspace fields.

413.description: Upload reservation exceeds configured maximum size

get.summary: Get upload metadata and processing status
get.description: Returns upload status. Stored workspace API keys can only read upload reservations owned by their own workspace.

200.description: Upload status

put.summary: Upload local media bytes to a signed UploadCheck URL

200.description: Upload bytes stored for a QC job

post.description: Registers a signed webhook endpoint. Stored workspace API keys force server-side workspace, owner, and key metadata onto the endpoint, ignoring client-supplied workspace fields.

get.description: Creates a signed preview delivery. Stored workspace API keys can preview only webhook endpoints owned by their own workspace.

200.description: Signed delivery preview

get.description: Lists webhook delivery attempts. Stored workspace API keys are pinned to their own workspace delivery log even if another webhook_id is supplied.

200.description: Webhook delivery log entries

post.summary: Retry a pending or failed webhook delivery
post.description: Retries a delivery. Stored workspace API keys can retry only deliveries owned by their own workspace.

200.description: Delivery attempt result

post.description: Processes due deliveries. Stored workspace API keys drain only pending deliveries owned by their own workspace; operator/admin bearer keys can drain globally.

200.description: Due delivery drain result

get.description: Reports whether the QC engine can run on this deployment: ffmpeg/ffprobe/python/yt-dlp/engine-script capability with ok|degraded|down status and a degraded_reason. No auth required; cached ~5 minutes. Agents should pre-flight this (or read engineStatus on /v1/qc/estimate) before uploading media.

200.description: Engine capability status

bearerApiKey.description: Workspace API key supplied as a bearer token.

profile.description: Effective QC profile after resolving profile:auto or aliases.

requestedProfile.description: Requested profile name before auto inference or alias normalization.

processingDurationMs.description: Wall-clock processing time in milliseconds from job start to completion.

failureReason.description: Failure or fallback reason when the engine cannot complete normally.

observability.description: Timing, engine, stage, provider-usage, and failure telemetry for job debugging and cost analysis.

mediaIngress.description: Sanitized media ingress metadata. Inline media is processed ephemerally without exposing temporary server paths.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the checked media bytes when UploadCheck handled the bytes directly.

sidecarIngress.description: Sanitized sidecar ingress metadata. Remote sidecar URLs are fetched into temporary storage for the run and are never exposed in public job responses.

sourceRedacted.description: True when an upload-backed local server path was removed from the public job response.

overageRevenueCents.description: Billable extra-minute spend at the plan overage rate; this is the alert trigger value.

overageRateCentsPerMinute.description: Customer overage price in cents per minute for the plan.

overageCostCents.description: Estimated overage COGS retained as audit context, not the trigger value.

workspaceId.description: Workspace that owns this upload reservation. Stored workspace API keys are pinned to this value.
Workspace that owns this webhook endpoint. Stored workspace API keys are pinned to this value.
Workspace that owns this delivery. Stored workspace API keys can only list, retry, or drain their own deliveries.
